section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch13 — Assessment & CCE
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A final examination held at the end of the academic year, used to certify overall achievement and assign a grade, rather than to guide ongoing instruction, is an example of:
explanation: Summative assessment evaluates learning at the END of an instructional period to certify achievement, contrasted with formative assessment, which occurs DURING instruction to guide ongoing teaching.
